entities.summary: Reginald Edward Manningham-Buller, 1st Viscount Dilhorne, known as Sir Reginald Manningham-Buller, Bt, from 1956 to 1962 and as The Lord Dilhorne from 1962 to 1964, was an English lawyer and Conservative politician. He served as Lord Chancellor from 1962 to 1964.
